# TurnkeyAI

> Done-for-you AI automation for Australian small and medium businesses. TurnkeyAI builds, configures, and deploys a fully operational autonomous AI agent in 7 business days, either on an Apple Mac Mini installed in your office or on a dedicated cloud server we manage. The agent runs your repetitive operational work (email, quotes, follow-ups, invoicing, CRM updates, scheduling) on its own, 24/7, controlled in plain English over Slack or Telegram. Based on the Gold Coast, Queensland; serving SMEs across Australia.

TurnkeyAI is operated by Mael Demets. Contact: start@tkai.com.au. Website: https://turnkeyai.com.au

## What TurnkeyAI is (and is not)

- It is a **done-for-you deployment service**, not a SaaS subscription. You pay once; you own the system.
- It deploys an **autonomous AI agent** (proactive: it acts on triggers and schedules by itself), not a reactive chatbot you have to prompt every time.
- The agent runs on the **OpenClaw** open-source agent runtime and is powered by **Anthropic's Claude** models.
- It is operated by non-technical staff via **Slack or Telegram in plain English**. No coding, no terminal.
- Sensitive actions (sending money, key-client replies, deletions) wait for one-tap human approval; routine work runs automatically.

## Pricing (one-time, AUD, ex-GST)

- **Cloud OpenClaw — $2,999 AUD**: the agent hosted on a dedicated VPS we manage, 3 custom autonomous workflows, Slack & Telegram control, connected to email/calendar/CRM, remote setup, 12 months hosting included, 2 weeks dedicated support.
- **Mac Mini — $5,999 AUD**: an Apple Mac Mini M4 installed in your office (hardware yours to keep), 5 custom autonomous workflows, on-site setup in Gold Coast or Brisbane, 2 weeks dedicated support.
- Both deploy live in **7 business days**. After the 2-week support window, support is **$200 AUD per intervention**, no subscription.

## Key facts and figures

- Deployment time: **7 business days**, guaranteed.
- Average client time/cost saving: **$1,000 to $2,000 per week**.
- Typical break-even: **about 3 weeks**.
- Australian SMEs deployed: **50+**.
- AI model: **Anthropic Claude**. Agent runtime: **OpenClaw** (open source). Data stays on the client's Mac Mini or dedicated VPS.

- [How to use AI in your business: a practical guide for Australian SMEs](https://turnkeyai.com.au/blog/posts/how-to-use-ai-in-your-business.html): The complete guide. Where to start, what AI can do, tools vs an autonomous agent, integration, cost, and common mistakes.

- [AI assistant vs AI agent: what your business needs](https://turnkeyai.com.au/blog/posts/ai-assistant-vs-ai-agent.html): An assistant is reactive (waits for you). An agent is proactive (runs whole workflows on its own). Which one a business actually needs.

- [Mac Mini AI server: the complete setup guide](https://turnkeyai.com.au/blog/posts/mac-mini-ai-server.html): Why a Mac Mini M4 is a strong local AI server for SMEs, with cost comparison vs cloud APIs.
- [The 3 questions that decide if AI will save you money](https://turnkeyai.com.au/blog/posts/the-3-questions.html): How to choose which role or workflow to automate first.
- [Why we install AI on a Mac Mini, not the cloud](https://turnkeyai.com.au/blog/posts/why-mac-mini.html): The on-premise case for SMB AI: ownership, data control, no subscription.
- [Inside our 7-day deployment](https://turnkeyai.com.au/blog/posts/7-day-deployment.html): Day-by-day breakdown of how a deployment runs.
- [How much AI automation costs in Australia](https://turnkeyai.com.au/blog/posts/ai-automation-cost-australia.html): Pricing models and real cost comparisons.
- [AI for accountants in Australia](https://turnkeyai.com.au/blog/posts/ai-for-accountants-australia.html): Seven workflows with compliance notes.
- [AI for real estate in Australia](https://turnkeyai.com.au/blog/posts/ai-for-real-estate-australia.html): Seven workflows with REIQ/REINSW notes.
- [How to integrate AI into a small business](https://turnkeyai.com.au/blog/posts/how-to-integrate-ai-into-small-business.html): A practical starting framework.

## Common questions

- **How long does deployment take?** Seven business days, guaranteed.
- **Do I need technical staff?** No. The agent is operated in plain English over Slack or Telegram.
- **Where does my data live?** On your Mac Mini or your dedicated VPS. Prompts are sent to Anthropic's API to run the model; Anthropic does not train on API data.
- **Is it a subscription?** No. One-time price. The Mac Mini is yours to keep. Cloud includes 12 months hosting.
- **What makes it different from ChatGPT, Claude Code, or Copilot?** Those are reactive assistants you must open and prompt. TurnkeyAI deploys a proactive, autonomous agent that runs workflows by itself, 24/7, on triggers and schedules.
